title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 14: Jonathan's attack on the Philistine garrison, Saul's rash oath, and Saul's family.

questions.text: To whom did Jonathan say, "Come! Let's go over to the Philistines' garrison"?
questions.explanation: Jonathan said this to the young man who bore his armor, but he didn't tell his father.

questions.text: Under what tree did Saul stay in the uttermost part of Gibeah?
questions.explanation: Saul stayed under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron.

questions.text: What were the names of the two rocky crags by the passes?
questions.explanation: The name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

questions.text: What did Jonathan choose as the sign that they should go up?
questions.explanation: If the Philistines said, "Come up to us!" they would go up, for Yahweh had delivered them into their hand.

answers.text: The Philistines saying, "Wait until we come to you!"
The Philistines saying, "Come up to us!"
A fire seen on top of the mountain

questions.text: About how many men fell in the first slaughter by Jonathan and his armor bearer?
questions.explanation: That first slaughter was about twenty men.

questions.text: What oath did Saul put on the people?
questions.explanation: Saul said, "Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies."

answers.text: Cursed is the man who flees from battle
Cursed is the man who eats food until evening
Cursed is the man who takes plunder
Cursed is the man who drinks water today

questions.text: Into what did Jonathan dip the end of his rod?
questions.explanation: He put out the end of the rod in his hand, dipped it in the honeycomb, and his eyes brightened.

questions.text: What does the text say about the altar Saul built to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Saul built an altar to Yahweh; this was the first altar that he built to Yahweh.

answers.text: It was built on the great stone at Beth Shemesh
It was destroyed the same day
It was the first altar he built to Yahweh

questions.text: What happened after Saul said that Jonathan would surely die?
questions.explanation: The people said not one hair of his head would fall, and they rescued Jonathan so that he didn't die.

questions.text: Who was the captain of Saul's army?
questions.explanation: The captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
